verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review platform with its own review agents, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question to ask. The pack shows only the reverse role: cubic publishes its own MCP server for coding agents to connect to, which does not count here. Its Jira, Linear, Asana and Notion connections are native integrations, not MCP, so nothing shows cubic consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.
